body.x: As part of the "Regional and Combined Sports Industry Promotion Project" sponsored by the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism and Daegu Metropolitan City (Daegu Sports Complex Industrial Support Center), Sae Young Information Communication Co. (CEO Lee Seh-Young) has exhibited WiWi at the CES 2017 (Consumer Technology Show), the world's largest IT appliance exhibition, held in Las Vegas, USA, through the Daegu Techno Park Sports Complex Industry Support Center.
(Photo Description (In order): SH-320, SH-350 G/M, SH-500, SH-380 G/M Product )

WiWi is a portable two-way radio transceiver using 2.4GHz, 900MHz ISM Band frequencies. One terminal acts as both a transmitter and a receiver, and up to six people can simultaneously talk in real time. If you have a mobile phone, you can listen to unlimited number of people, and the size of just two fingers and light weight of 39g makes it excellent for both domestic and foreign buyers.

WiWi providing high-quality audio transmission / reception service can communicate with up to 10km when wired repeaters and wireless bridges are installed with a maximum communication distance of 500m.

WiWi is lightweight, easy to operate and has excellent sound quality, which has quickly become popular in tour guides, global business meetings, sports, broadcasting and industrial sites. WiWi is already attracting attention in various fields such as Cheongwadae, National Security Center, control room, museum, Incheon headquarters customs, school, horse riding sports and so on because it is not limited by its usage.
WiWi and Wireless Bridge (UP-300) have been selected for the second year in a row for 2015 and 2016 by the Ministry of National Defense.

It is also supplying products to all of Europe, USA and Southeast Asian markets, starting with Japan. Currently, it exports 70% of its total sales volume, and WiWi is available through agents in 13 countries.

On the other hand, Daegu Techno Park, Kyungpook National University Smart Venture Business School and Kyungpook National University Smart Drone Technology Center opened the CES Daegu Joint Pavilion and support the exhibition management and business buyer consultation of 22 companies.

CES, the world's largest IT exhibition, is an annual showcase of the global consumer electronics industry, held every January by the American Consumer Electronics Association (CTA). The global news network, which reported the most issues of CES, MWC and IFA, the world's top three tech exhibitions over the past decade, has sent a special report team to CES this year to report major issues in the global market.
